map.分项录入硬装、主材、家具、家电等装修支出，实时汇总总金额、各项占比与累计进度，支: Enter hard decoration, main materials, furniture and appliances item by item, and see the total, the share of each item and the cumulative progress in real time, with local draft saving, helping owners track budget execution throughout the renovation and identify overspending.
map.硬装 / 主材 / 家具 / 家电分项列支，实时看各项占比，发现主材超 40%: List hard decoration, main materials, furniture and appliances item by item, see each share in real time, and adjust the structure in time when main materials exceed 40%.
map.设总预算上限，用累计进度看已花比例，避免末端超支无钱收尾。: Set a total budget cap and use the cumulative progress to see how much has been spent, so you do not run out of money at the end.
map.用浏览器 localStorage 存草稿，分多次录入；换设备前先截图 / 导出: Use browser localStorage to store the draft and enter it over several sessions; screenshot or export a backup before changing device.
map.算例（硬装 8 + 主材 12 + 家具 5 + 家电 4 万）: Worked example (hard decoration 8 + main materials 12 + furniture 5 + appliances 4, in ten thousand CNY)
map.：合计 29 万；占比 硬装 27.6%、主材 41.4%、家具 17.2%、家: Total 290,000; shares hard decoration 27.6%, main materials 41.4%, furniture 17.2%, appliances 13.8%. With a total cap of 300,000, main materials are already near the limit, so compress or downgrade the appliance tier.
map.各项占比怎么看健康？: How do I judge health from the share of each item?
map.常见区间：硬装 25–35%、主材 30–45%、家具 15–25%、家电 10: Typical ranges: hard decoration 25-35%, main materials 30-45%, furniture 15-25%, appliances 10-20%. Main materials above 45% or hard decoration below 20% are both unbalanced, the former squeezing out soft furnishings and the latter possibly hiding extra charges.
map.数据存在哪、会丢吗？: Where is the data stored, and can it be lost?
map.仅存浏览器 localStorage（按域名隔离），清缓存 / 换浏览器会丢。重: Stored only in the browser's localStorage (isolated per domain), so clearing the cache or switching browser loses it. Screenshot or export important budgets yourself; this tool neither connects to the network nor uploads anything.
